text: Balance a spoon on your nose for 30 seconds. Timer starts now.
Draw a cat using exactly five lines. No erasing. Show no mercy.
Text the third person in your chats a single potato emoji. No context. No follow-up.
Do 10 push-ups. Or 10 dramatic collapses onto the couch. Your call.
Speak in a movie-trailer voice for the next two minutes. “In a world…”
Try to name 15 countries in 30 seconds. Out loud. Bonus points for confidence.
Put your phone on your head and balance it while walking to the kitchen and back.
Whistle an entire song. If you can't whistle, hum it like you mean it.
Make the ugliest face you can and hold it for 15 seconds.
Write your name with your non-dominant hand. Frame the result mentally.
Stand up and spin around 10 times, then walk in a straight line. Good luck.
Impersonate your favorite celebrity ordering a pizza. Commit to the bit.
Build the tallest tower you can from things within arm's reach. You have 60 seconds.
Say the alphabet backwards. Slowly. Painfully. Completely.
Hold a plank until this sentence ends. …Still going? Okay, you can stop.
Find something in the room that starts with the letter Q. Harder than it sounds.
Do your best robot dance for exactly one chorus of a song only you can hear.
Stare at a wall and narrate it like a nature documentary for 30 seconds.
Try to lick your own elbow. Science says you can't. Prove science wrong.
Invent a handshake with an imaginary friend. Teach it to them properly.
Count how many steps it takes to walk to your front door. Blindfolded? No. Just count.
Make a paper airplane and throw it. Wherever it lands, that's your new favorite spot.
Hum a song and make someone (or the void) guess it. The void is a tough crowd.
Freeze. Don't move for 45 seconds. Blinking is allowed. Barely.
